data.name: Big Island Grand Circle Island Tour
data.headline: 11 Hours • Most Popular • See Highlights of Big Island in a Day
data.description: This full-day nature tour offers an in-depth look at Hawaii’s youngest and largest island. Discover diverse landscapes as you explore Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, walk through rainforests to cascading waterfalls, and stroll black-sand beaches and look for sea turtles! Your professional guide will also share knowledge of the island's rich history, cultures, and geology.

highlight_box.title: Big Island Grand Circle Island Tour
highlight_box.description: Explore Hawaii’s Big Island, showcasing its diverse landscapes—from volcanoes and rainforests to black sand beaches and waterfalls—while experiencing 8 of the world’s 13 climate zones.

data.itinerary:
- Visit a Kona Coffee Farm, stroll through the orchards, learn about harvesting and milling, and sample freshly brewed Kona coffee.

- Relax at Punaluʻu Black Sand Beach, a great spot to spot green sea turtles along the black-sand shore.

- Explore Hawaiʻi Volcanoes National Park — see steam vents, past lava flows, Kīlauea craters, and walk through the 600-foot-long Thurston Lava Tube.

- Visit the island’s iconic waterfalls:
  Akaka Falls — a 442-foot (135 m) cascade surrounded by lush rainforest.
  Rainbow Falls — an 80-foot (24 m) waterfall beside a massive banyan tree.

- Drive along the scenic Hamakua Coast and end the day with breathtaking sunset views at Waipiʻo Valley Lookout, where verdant cliffs meet the ocean.

data.booking_notes:
**Things to Bring and Wear**

Wear comfortable clothing in layers as temperatures vary from warm to cool. We recommend bringing a rain jacket and wearing covered walking shoes. Please bring your **America the Beautiful Pass** if you have one. 

**Included in the Tour**

Local style picnic lunch consists of teriyaki chicken, fish, sweet potato, and steamed rice with assorted juices, snacks, and bottled water. In addition, all park entrance fees, mosquito repellent, and rain gear.

**Not included in the tour**

Tour guide gratuities. Tipping is a great way to show appreciation for the hard work and dedication it takes to be a guide.

**Look for our Mercedes Sprinter van with Wasabi Tours Hawaii logo at your pickup location**

data.faqs:
**How much hiking do we do?**
A: We will have a couple of easy hikes over a short distance on this tour. The total hiking distance throughout the day is around 1.5 miles.

**How long do we stop at Volcanoes National Park?**
A: We stop at multiple attractions within the park for a total time of about 1.5 hours

**Do we get to swim at the black sand beach or waterfalls on this tour?**
A: You won’t be able to swim on this tour due to time constraints. If you would like to swim at a private waterfall, please check out our Big Island Waterfalls Adventure.

**What's the difference between the Twilight Volcano Tour and Circle Island Tour?**
A: Both tours feature a Kona coffee farm, Punalu'u black sand beach, and Hawai‘i Volcanoes National Park. The Circle Island Tour adds two waterfalls and Waipio Valley Lookout with about 1.5 hours in the national park, while the Twilight Volcano Tour offers about 3 hours in the national park, a restaurant dinner, and stargazing near Mauna Kea.
